newsitem.title: LEBANON: Lebanon foreign debt rises to $1.77 bln in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Lebanon foreign debt rises to $1.77 bln in 1996.

text.p: Lebanon's 1996 foreign debt rose $464.3 million to $1,768.9 million at the end of December, the Bank of Lebanon said in its latest monthly bulletin on Tuesday.
The foreign debt stood at $1,304.6 million in December 1995.
"External debt rose by $464.3 million in 1996 against a rise of $532.8 million in 1995, and registered $1,768.9 million at end of 1996 of which $800 million were Eurobonds," the report said.
Net total public debt rose to 16,103.5 billion pounds in 1996 from 11,378 billion at the end of 1995, registering an annual rise of 41.35 percent against 43.07 percent in 1995, the Bank added.

"The increase in debt was mainly due to the rise in net domestic debt, which reached 13,358.2 billion at end of December against 9,295.9 billion at end December 1995...This increase represented 85.97 percent of the rise in net total public debt," the bank added.
